messages:
ryan: quick note — customer with encrypted safetensors bundles showed high cold-starts. initial idea: decrypt a tiny signed manifest first, then hydrate prioritized shards.

emily: do you mean manifest contains per-shard role hints (kv, base, quant) and we schedule accordingly?

ryan: exactly. manifest = bundle_id, shard table, hint_role, enc_meta, signature. small so KMS decrypt + verify is cheap and cacheable.

tessa: sounds good. couple concerns: KMS rate limits and trust. propose header cache (bundle+keyv) and require signed manifests for trusting hints. unsigned manifests -> conservative schedule.

ryan: agree. also implement host semaphore for concurrent payload decrypts to avoid KMS storms. manifest triggers only scheduling, payload decrypts gated.

emily: loader API changes? add options manifest_first:true and events on_manifest_ready/on_shard_ready. Keep default behavior if missing.

tessa: add metrics: manifest_decrypt_ms, manifest_verify_ms, time_to_first_shard_ms, concurrent_decrypts. Ops: per-host sidecar decryptor by default; private customers can centralize.

security-bot: noted. Created ticket INF-4333: "manifest-first staged hydration" (assignee: ryan).

ryan: plan spike next week. volunteers emily + tessa for prototype. will sketch RFC tonight.

emily: cool. we should also define fallback policy if top-n shard fetch fails (try replica, then fallback model variant).

tessa: and TTL/invalidate hook for manifest cache on key rotation.

ryan: thanks all :thumbsup:
